verdict.rationale: LM Studio's Bionic agent can be directed in natural language, by text or real-time transcribed speech, to create and edit documents and run agentic tasks, and a hands-on user says it 'works great.' Core product operations such as loading models, downloading and serving are only shown via the `lms` CLI, GUI and REST API, not natural-language control. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can operate LM Studio itself (model management, server control, configuration), in-depth docs on Bionic's command scope, broader independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Talk to Bionic naturally, and your speech gets transcribed in real time.
Work with Bionic to create and edit documents. Every change is automatically saved, so you can work with your agent freely.
use them for simple chats or advanced agentic tasks
I gave Bionic a shot immediately. First impression: it works great
